COURSE TITLE    ECONOMICS I
COURSE CODE     10BA2102
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To build an understanding of basic concepts of Micro components of Economics
 2  To enable students to analyze theories, laws and of concepts of Microeconomics
 3  To enable students to apply various laws for forecasting demand and supply, and consumer
     equilibrium, pricing, production optimization.
 4  To enable students to evaluate various laws with exceptions and limitations.
 5  To develop a higher-level thinking of the interface between Law and Economics by
     discussion of applications various concepts in Law which have been derived from
    Economics.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Develop acquaintance with the functioning of various Micro concepts in the real-world
    phenomenon.
 2  Analyze various legal and economic issues and which are often found to be strongly
     associated with each other and develop meaningful solutions for the same.
 3  Comprehend the structural framework and functioning of various Laws and Acts which are
      built upon various Economic Theories and Principles.


Pre-requisite of course:N/A

objectives: To provide an understanding of the law's meaning, importance, and role in society
To provide an understanding of the nature & development of law and legal systems
To know the structure of the legal institutions and the hierarchy of courts in India.

To know the various sources of law and be able to synthesize such sources and use them to formulate arguments in their research; be familiar with legal research sources and tools and basic techniques of legal and logical reasoning.
course_outcomes: Understand the concept, sources, and functions of law and various legal systems of the world.
Understand the hierarchy of the Indian courts and their jurisdictions
Understand judicial reasoning and its application in the Courts.
Acquire the ability to identify legal issues and principles underlying any given factual situation and to undertake and present research on such issues.
Equip with the basics of legal research methodology and legal writing. Pre-requisite of course:N/A

COURSE TITLE    LEGAL METHODS
COURSE CODE     10FL2101
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To provide an understanding of the law's meaning, importance, and role in society
 2  To provide an understanding of the nature & development of law and legal systems
 3  To know the structure of the legal institutions and the hierarchy of courts in India.
 4  To know the various sources of law and be able to synthesize such sources and use them to
     formulate arguments in their research; be familiar with legal research sources and tools and
     basic techniques of legal and logical reasoning.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand the concept, sources, and functions of law and various legal systems of the
     world.
 2  Understand the hierarchy of the Indian courts and their jurisdictions
 3  Understand judicial reasoning and its application in the Courts.
 4  Acquire the ability to identify legal issues and principles underlying any given factual
     situation and to undertake and present research on such issues.
 5  Equip with the basics of legal research methodology and legal writing.


Pre-requisite of course:N/A

COURSE TITLE    SOCIOLOGY I
COURSE CODE     10BA2103
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To provide the background of the subject and its relevance in studying society
 2  To help the students understand basic concepts in sociology which will help in better
     understanding of society.
 3  To introduce basic issues and themes and various perspectives concerning social problems.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand and appreciate the social institutions and organizations.
 2  Apply sociological concepts and will be able to relate with society.
 3  Examine social problems and evaluate their various dimensions.
